$comment: Every product shot the site references. tools/shots must produce /shots/<name>.webp at exactly this pixel size from the real app (never stock or mocked images). 'show' is what must be on screen. Until a file exists the site renders a neutral placeholder; rebuild the site after adding files.

hero-before.alt: A raw screenshot of an account settings page, with an email address and an API key visible and ragged edges around the window.
hero-before.show: The unprocessed capture of a real settings or dashboard window, straight from region capture: uneven desktop edges still visible, no padding, no shadow, an email address and an API key legible on screen.

hero-after.alt: The same screenshot after Polishot: trimmed, framed on a matching background, with the email address and the API key covered.
hero-after.show: The same capture as hero-before after one pass: edges trimmed, even padding, an auto-matched background sampled from the edges, rounded corners, soft shadow, and the email and API key covered by blur or solid bars. Exported as a 16:10 image.

balance.alt: The Polishot editor with the background set to Auto and the padding slider in view.
balance.show: The desktop editor window with a screenshot that has uneven borders being balanced: the Inspector open on Background with 'Auto' selected, the padding control visible, and the framed result on the canvas.

redact.alt: The redaction panel listing an email address, a card number, an IP address and an API key found in a screenshot.
redact.show: The editor's redaction panel listing detections as chips (an email, a card number, an IPv4 address, an API key) with their boxes outlined on the screenshot. One chip is toggled off. The 'Blur' and 'Bar' apply buttons are visible.

ocr.alt: A line of text selected inside a screenshot, ready to copy.
ocr.show: A screenshot of an error dialog or terminal with one line of text selected through the OCR text layer: a selection highlight over the words and a small 'Copied' confirmation visible.

export.alt: The export panel with social size presets and format options.
export.show: The export panel: the preset list (X, LinkedIn, Instagram square, Instagram story, YouTube) with one selected, format PNG, scale 2x, and the 16:9 preview on the canvas.

quick-send.alt: A Windows notification that an image arrived from a phone, next to the phone's send screen.
quick-send.show: Until real device captures exist (needs a CI installer and a phone), an illustration built from the real desktop window and the Android strings/colours: the Windows quick-send 'Received from phone' notification with the image preview, and the Android Polishot screen sending that image, both showing the same six-digit pairing code.
